column2: D Day. The Landing.
Approx location Drop Zone C
Approx location Drop Zone D
Take all your objectives by Paradrop, split your force to deal with the obectives simultaneously.
Remember to go easy on the "Tommies" as they are our allies!!
Please purchase no new units unless replacing lost ones.

You have to move your air transport units where you want (and hope that AI has no AD or air units close), then where and when you want (you don't have to use your paratroops at the very 1st turn, you can wait) you deploy the paratroops.
Take all objectives by Paradrop.
Deploy 11 Airborne units in Air Transports.
You also may deploy 2 Airborne units on the ground.
Well Bob this is the day we have waited for these last few years...the day we launch our attack on 'Fortress Europe'
Land your regiment on the drop zones "C" and "D" and hold them to allow the 401st Glider Infantry Regiment to land.
Deploy 16 Airborne units in Air Transports.
1st and 2nd Battalions are to take "Exit No. 2" while 3rd Battalion and the Engineers are to take "Exit No. 1" and Pouppeville, where after good intelligence a tough fight is expected.
1st and 2nd Battalions are to take "Exit No. 2" while 3rd Battalion and the Engineers are to take "Exit No. 1" and Pouppeville.
NB : Sea planes can be repaired and resupplied on allied ground airfield or carrier.
We have located a battery of 105mm guns that are firing on Utah beach and have the potential to inflict damage on our assault force.
You are to send a detachment to the area around Ste. Marie du Mont and destroy these guns then capture the town.
Move your troops through the town of Vierville and down the road to St. Come du Mont.
Engage the enemy wherever he appears and capture the town.
The battle plan is as follows:-
The British 1st Airborne Division is to land on the clear ground northwest of Arnhem, protect this dropzone for the 2nd drop tomorrow and advance towards Arnhem.

The US 82nd Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 504th south of Nijmegan to capture the north and south bridges and the 505th to land near Grave and capture the Grave bridge and protect their dropzone in preperation for Glider-borne reinforcement.

The US 101st Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 501st south of Veghal to take the canal bridge, and the 506th to land north of Eindhoven to take the northern bridges, protect the dropzone for Glider-borne reinforcement and enter the city, then to hold the road open for the 30th Corps' advance.
Good luck to all.
Deploy 13 Airborne units in Air Transports.

The British 1st AB will continue it's assault on Arnhem with the objective being to capture and hold the northern end of the bridge until it can be reinforced by Paradrop and Gliders. They must also hold their Drop Zone.

The US 82nd AB is to hold Nijmegan, the Grave bridge and their Drop Zones. Assault boats will be delivered as soon as possible to allow the 504th to cross the Maas river upstream and attack the north end of the bridge while the 30th Corps attacks from the south. The 82nd AB is not permitted to advance beyond the northern end of Nijmegan bridge.

The US 101st AB is to hold the road between Eindhoven and Grave open at all costs. Also the Veghel bridge,and their two Drop Zones. Engineers are working on a temporary bridge at Son which will allow the 30th Corps to continue it's advance. The 101st AB is not permitted to advance beyond Grave.
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on your Victory Hexes in the city of Eindhoven.
We are at a critical stage of the battle Bob.
The British will hold onto the north end of Arnhem bridge and their Drop Zone if they can and hope the 30th Corps can get through in time to relieve them.

The 82nd and 101st ABs will hold their bridges and the road open at any cost. SHAEF cannot stress how important it is this road is held. The success or failure of the entire battle hinges on this objective.
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on 3 of your Victory Hexes.
You may purchase 1 new Paratrooper Mortar Team (or upgrade) and 1 new Paratrooper Bazooka Team.
2 x Paratrooper Mortar Team(or upgrade)
2 x Paratrooper Bazooka Team
Polish Para Brigade Drop Zone
Move your troops by truck to the new front line north of the Waal River and south of the Lower Rhine River, an area known as "The Island". Once in position hold the line at all costs until relieved.
We have reports of an elite heavy unit operating in the area.
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on your Victory Hexes at Eindhoven, Grave and Nijmegen.
1 x Paratrooper Scout( or upgrade)
Assemble your troops around Sedan and await orders to move out. It is expected that you will be heading to Bastogne.
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on your Ownership Hexes near Sedan and move as fast as you can to north and occupy Bastogne, Langchamps and Compogne. You must recapture all VH's Germans might take.
Defenders of Bastogne

We will accept the honorable surrender of the encircled town of Bastogne to be accomplished in two hours. Failure to accept will result in the complete annihilation of the defenders by the massed fire of our artillery. Break the encirclement and conquer Nadrin, Martelange as well as the forests located at the North-east of Bastogne.
General Anthony McAuliffe,
Commander 101st Airborne Division.
NUTS!!!!!
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on your 3 Bastogne Victory Hexes. Wait for the 4th to arrive before attempting a breakout out!!
Now it's our turn to attack!!
Push back the German front to the Siegfried Line.
Place your 3 Battalion HQ units on your 3 Bastogne Victory Hexes.

Send a Recon and Engineeer group into the southern side of Haguenau and eliminate any defences you find there. The rest of your regiment will follow when the way is clear. If any targets become available on the northern side of the River Moder you are given permission to cross the river and take them out.
There are plenty of Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough house to house fighting.
Deploy 2 Engineers, 1 Recon and an Infantry unit of your choice. Put your 3 Infantry units in 1/2 tracks.

Bob you have been given the task of rescuing your captured men from the temporary camp we believe they are being held in. Our intelligence suggests that the camp is in a large open area South-east of your Battalion HQ's. I can't stress enough how dangerous this mission is and that you will be completely cut off from our lines. You must absolutely reach the objective located somewhere within the Camp area.
Good Luck Bob
As a reward for you Divisions' couragous efforts in this war, you have been given the priviledge of taking the ultimate prize- Hitler's mountain home 'Berchtesgaden'.
Cross the canal at the lock near Bad Reichenhall follow the road through the mountains and assault the complex to capture the Nazi flag and claim your prize.
Watch out for the fanatical SS men who will do everything to stop you.
Send your Regiment into the northern side of Haguenau and eliminate any defences you find there. If any targets become available to the north of Haguenau you are given permission to take them out.
There are reports of many Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough fighting.

After the capture of Bristol, the last important point in our plans on the West coast of England is the city of Gloucester, if we destroy the British resistance here, we will take the control of all this area. Intelligence and our recon flights report us that the British have built here a good defensive line, using the rivers and the city. You will receive reinforcements from two Panzer Divisions, also you the 22nd FJ Division will help us again. Good Luck.
Caen - Operation Goodwood PeG:
Sollum Battle and Halfaya Pass

Reports from the Fort Capuzzo and Halfaya Pass garrisons indicates that the British are preparing an assault over our positions. Sollum has been taken by the enemy, and surely the Italians will be eliminated from the Pass. Your divisions must drive to the Fort Capuzzo to face the enemy offensive, and avoid a possible attack over our important backwards positions on Bardia and Sidi Azeiz. Italian units from the 5a Squadra Aereonautica will arrive to help you later.
Historically, this was the last operation of the general Wavell in North Africa, after the high command pulled him out. This operation was called "Operation Brevity"\x00
1/9SS
2/9SS
Ah General, Come in.
You've got a tough nut to crack this time.
You've got to take Almaty quickly.
If you don't, Ivan will have time to get forces into the mountains and we'll never get them out.
The British attempt to smash Rommel's armor south of Tobruk.  Rommel
launches a counter-attack in the afternoon.  By sunset, every British unit
trying to get to the "Cauldron" has been driven back.
Caen - Operation Charnwood: Redux
British commander Bernard Montgomery promised the Allied command
that his troops would capture the old city of Caen on the first day of the
Normandy landings. After weeks of hard, bloody fighting, Montgomery
attempts to make good on his promise.
The German troops try to clear Polish forces from Mlawa and Ciechanow.
The Polish army attempts to defend their homeland against the German
invaders.
Autum 1942 - September 5th, 1942
Caucasus oilfields -oil and petroleum- and strategic raw materials might be available for our units.
Kongratulieren!, the past year frontlines have been restored here.
This is a real important victory!, the British have been completely surprised by your South "hook". The Gazala Line is destroyed, and also, Tobruk has fallen in our hands. Kongratulieren.
Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that the Operation Hercules will be launched in the next hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding results.

You are victorious! Unfortunately it's a Pyrhus Victory because you have suffered too many losses, as a result the assault in Egypt demands fresh troops. Report to the Führer immediately in Berlin for your promotion, you've earned the Knight cross with brilliants, sword and oak leaves. The Führer wants more troops on the Eastern front for Stalingrad and the Caucasus campaign, you might convince him to change his mind and exploit your advantage in the Mediterranian with reinforcements.
Obviously, you need to take a rest. Another General will replace you now as Commander in Chief of the DAK. (You are dismissed).
You have selected the path to assault Egypt, in case of success the road to oil in the Middle East and the reconquest of former Italian colonies in South Afrika are at hand.
You haven't chosen any path, please try it again.
Klin PeG:WW2
November 1st, 1942
Herr General you have the choice of continuing the historic line (in Tunisia) or moving into an alternative series of scenarios depicting an hypothetical German attack plan (through Egypt).
If you want to continue with the historic line move to "Tunis".
If you want to follow the alternative line move to "Alexandria".
March 31st, 1941

After the first success agaisnt the Brits (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The Brits are withdrawing their troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive onwards to Benghazi, and later to Mechilli. This way, Cyrenaica would be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.

Playing tip : don't lose your Mobil Armee HQ unit since there are no supply hexes in this scenario. Deploy and Supply units allow to re-supply and give replacements to any ground or air unit even after it has moved as long as the unit ends up within 2 hexes of the Deploy and Supply unit. They allow the unit to retreat and re-supply on the same turn. Be aware that in the desert full re-supply only occurs in towns, ports, airfields and rough terrain. Those units have also the bridging ability.
BLITZKRIEG! OBJECTIVE FRANCE
Blitzkrieg!: Objective France
May - June 1940
German Campaign: 1940
Campaign designer: Santiago Fuertes, 2005

The invasion of France has begun!, after the conquest of Poland in 1939, and with the still unfinished Operation Weserübung, the Wehrmacht has crossed the Ardennes Forest, and you are the general with the duty of manage the attack, starting at Sedan, where the French Army will surely be completely surprised. Can you drive the Wehrmacht to Paris?
Halfaya Pass and Sollum Battle
November 18th, 1941

A lot of armoured units has been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the Tommies are trying to stop our assault over Tobruk, which is completely besieged now. Unfortunately, we should stop the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. In the other hand, beware with the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they would be able to attack us from behind.

Historically, in this moment the DAK was composed of the 15 Panzer Division, the 21 Panzer Division (formerly 5 Leichte Division, 5 LD) plus 6 Italian Divisions (many of them with outdated equipment). The Operation Crusader was finally an stalemate, but the DAK withdrawed its positions, and in December the 24th, Benghazi came again into the Allied hands.\x00
January 21, 1942

The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have recaptured Cyrenaica again. Now, we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points, we will be able to besiege Benghazi again, and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
January 25, 1942

After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. That units are surely the remnants of the 1st Armored division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate that is deployed around Bengazhi.
The mission is re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
Viel Glück Herr General!
Gazala Line(Operation Theseus)
May 26th, 1942

The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on to Egypt.

Your task is to accomplish the codenamed "Operation Theseus". This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.
Viel Glück!.

Congratulations Herr Feldsmarschall!!, the high command have promoted you due to your good results in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place, anyway the reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. In the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objective is to make a fast assault from the South, like in Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastests units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
August 31st, 1942

The high command thinks that it's time to strike the enemy again, like in the past, surprising the Allies from the South. Your task is to surround the enemy from the South, and capture the Alexandria Supplyline. The Alam Halfa ridge is an important and strategical place, you must secure it also. Viel Gluck!.
Historically, the Germans had an important lack of supplies, fuel, and tanks. This attack was ordered due to political pressions, a quick victory was needed...

The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy air superiority, plus the minefileds, are making a big amount of losses into our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.

Historically, the British had decoded the German "Enigma" codes and knew all the German plans, Montgomery was able to made special plans to kick out the Germans from El Alamein. Marshall Rommel didn't follow the order of fight at any cost, and in November the 12th, he started the retreat of the DAK.
Playing tip: Drop airborne units to capture victory hexes!
Excellent, you have captured the oil reserves located at Tebessa.
Your next operation will be: try to enclose the Angloamerican's Armies toward Bone.
You couldn't make allies to get back in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunizia with the few units we have.

Angloamerican forces have disembarked in French land, moving at full speed toward Tunisia. After you recent victory in Alexandria, we cannot afford a counterattack from behind. Due to your inexperienced rivals, their positions are very week, but they are more in number and supplies.
Your mission: Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
Note: In Tebessa, Allies used to have a great oil reserve, if you capture the city, you will be able to perform future offensive operations.
The Angloamerican attempt to surprise us from behind was a complete failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
You have fail to make allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
Thanks to you great successes, now we have the possibility to surround the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, city of Bone.
With the prestige you've gained, now you can get equiped with new units and make upgrades.
Your failure in the invasion on Malta, will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where the prestige will be lacking.

Finally, after the complete defeat of the main British units at El Alamein, we can assault the strongly important port of Alexandria. Unfortunately, some units enemy have escaped from El Alamein area, and now they are trying to set up defences around Alexandria, and also into the city. Air Recon reports shows that the Royal Navy has came to protect the port, our Italian friends will send the Regia Marina to help us in the assault, and to face the Royal Navy.
All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control!, only the Suez Kanal remains under British domination... We shall see how long they can use the Kanal!
Port Said (Operation Rotterdam), November 9th, 1942

We cannot leave the entrance of the Port under the British control, however we must send our main units to overrun El Cairo. Following that ideas, the High Command have designed an operation to take Port Said using few units, like in May of 1940 in the Low Countries.
Operation Rotterdam
1. Use the elite units of the Raemcke brigade and the Folgore division to take far mission objectives, like Port Said and El Qmic.
2. The ground forces must take Darakisha and El Matariya, and then, drive to the Kanal. Maybe the air elite units would need help.
3. The 101 Italian Trieste division should drive directly to Port Said.
4. You should complete the operation as soon as possible, because the assault on El Cairo must begin in two or three days.
Excellent job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
El Cairo is in front of us, after more than one year of battles in Afrika, we are starting the final assault to the British stronghold of Egypt.

The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our surrender. Now, we must assault the city in order to end the British control over North Africa.
El Cairo has been cleared. Now, the next aim is to complete the conquest of the Suez Kanal.

After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez, as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports says that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon, so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible future meeting with the Americans in the next months.
You have selected the path towards South Afrika, you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.
Gothic Choice
Gothic Line West
You have selected the path to ensure the oil routes going through Syria, Irak and Persia.
March 1st, 1943

This is a choice scenario, after the fall of Egypt, and the defeat of the Allied invaders over the Vichy France African territories, you should decide where the Deutsches Afrika Korps will go this time. We have made two different plans:

BV: This means to select the plan proposed by our Italian friends: the recapture of Erythrea, Ethiopia, and Somaliland, and then, going towards South following the Nile river. To select this path move south to "East Africa" hex.

V or TV: By selecting this path, you will go to ensure the Mediterran Sea, the oil paths and, the chance to open a second front in the Caucasus, piercing into Persia. To select this path move east to "Middle East" hex.

We'd crossed the Channel, and now we are going to the Mediterran's coast, but even now here are the remnants of the 8th British Army and a Egyptian complete division, so you have to destroy them. Our Intelligence report says that anti-Britain Palestine groups will be present behind the enemy positions to support us.
Smolensk - July 17th, 1946
Commander, The city of Smolensk is your next objective. You will have some help from the 10th Mountain and 2nd Rangers. You must take the city by the end of the month.
Good luck Commander.

We are closing to the land where the very first people loved by Hitler were originated (kiddin'). The High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS to "silence" the sector.
Be quickly as you can and close the Mediterranean's coast to avoid enemy reinforcements.

We are in the doors of the Iraqi Capital City, the main obstacle is the Arab Legion and the 10th Indian Division brought as reinforcements, so do whatever you can and take the needed oil for the Deutsches Reich!

After the fall of Baghdad, we won't suffer anymore the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with more petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please, let me a moment to explain you the Persian situation:

In the past years, Persia was a pro-German country, however, in the first days of 1943 the Soviets, aided by some remaining British units who escaped from other fronts, (mainly of the 8th Army), have invaded the country. The King of Persia, Reza Shah have abdicated, forced by the invaders. Fortunately for us, some Persian army officers, loyals to Reza Shah, have contacted us, offering their help to kick out the Soviets and the British from Persia. Intelligence reports that the Armed Persian Police, and the weak Persian Air Force will remain under the enemy control, also, a good number of Soviet tanks have been spotted. There is an only airstrip near to Tehran, so you must take it to allow our airforce to be resupplied here.
Your task is to aid the Persian "rebels" to clear Teheran. With a success here, Persia will surely be an important ally in the coming years.

Kongratulieren!, the Soviets have been kicked out from Persia, and the British Armies will no longer disturb us here. The Middle East is under our command as well as the oil resources from this land. In spite of the failure at Stalingrad, our presence in Persia will bring some trouble at the Soviet South borders. We hope the Kursk offensive will be a decisive victory for the Werhmacht, helped now by our big amount of oil supplies...
(You have managed the DAK better than Rommel, congratulations General!)
The allies have been stop you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
We'd started to advance toward south direction, we are in Keren doors, however this city won't give us any trouble the main resistance is in the mountains.
The Italians are grateful because we help them to recover their colonies
If we acquire Massawa's Port, all the Erythrea will be ours, so Afrikans won't have any choice but surrender prior to receive supplies. Beware, some ships of Royal Navy are defending the Port.
Kongratulieren!, you have achieved the High Command objectives. The enemy forces are divided in two, and the drive to the French Channel can continue.
The Allies have been stopped you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
We're in the door of the conquest of all the Italians had lost, the last resistance point is located here in Mogadishu. Be careful, don't underestimate the Royal Navy.
The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and thank you for playing.
The Soviet super tank is crushed. The base has been captured, but in the
amount of time it took to accomplish our objectives the Soviets may have been
able to transmit the schematics...let's hope they never got that chance.

This is the last strategic point controlled by the British in the Indian's coast, once we will take it, the allies will be unable to counterattack, because we will have in our hands all the important ports. The configuration of the Mombasa City makes the assault very tough and the presence of the Royal Navy, will push your command to the extreme, but we trust you.
Good luck Herr General!
This zone of Algiers is secure, Italian detachments will stay behind and we will continue our unstoppable advance.
The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot do any more attacks, we will only defend our positions because our units are in bad shape!

After you have destroyed the Angloamerican forces in Bone and stopped the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers in order to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
1. The italian naval aircraft Re 2001 can be repaired and resupplied on its carrier and on any Axis airfield.

2. The Mine layer boat as well as the carrier can be used to deploy mines: after deployment of ground units exit the deployment screen, select a ship then click on the "deploy forces" button, only then you can deploy sea mines wherever you move the ship at any game turn.

We keep on our unstoppable advance by the Afrikan coasts. Now Oran in the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clean it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and make this conquest an impossible duty to perform.
We have just one step left to kick-out the americans from the east coast, start to move!

We have left Algiers and are now in Morocco, your quick advance didn't give our enemies time to strengthen their defensive positions. You have to advance faster and avoid the mistakes you have already made in the past.
There is a heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.

You will be assisted by Kriegsmarine units, OKW has decided to mine the Mediterranean sea in the sector of Medhia Harbor in order to submit the Royal Navy to a blockade before the arrival of a "Wolfpack" of submarines.
